# ReviewBuddy

> ReviewBuddy helps Australian trade businesses get more Google reviews and shows them, with the other review sites they connect, in one view on their own website. Setup is done for the customer.

## What it does

- Gives each business a direct Google review link and QR code to share after every job.
- Brings reviews from the other sites a business connects, such as Service Seeking and hipages, together with Google.
- Shows a business's best Google reviews on its own website. They update when a new review comes in.
- Growth plan: emails that ask customers for a review, one reminder, past customers loaded in, and a weekly tip.
- Free setup for the next 200 clients. The site shows how many spots are left from a real count.

## Offer and prices

- Free for 7 days. Cancel with one email.
- Free setup on both plans, plus a weekly tip.
- Starter: $49 a month, GST included. For tradies who'll ask in person.
- Growth: $75 a month, GST included. For tradies who'd rather we did the asking.
- Start free trial goes to a Stripe payment link, then on to registration. The trial isn't stored on this website.
